law.name: angle-modulated quadratic smooth-min (sin^2 law)
law.formula: k' = k * (1 - dot(na, nb)) / 2 ;  d = min(a, b) - max(k' - |a - b|, 0)^2 / (4 k')   (k' -> 0 gives min)
equivalent_forms: k' = k * sin^2(theta/2) where theta = angle between the operand SDF gradients na, nb
morph mix form liquidSmin(a, b, k') with the per-point k'
law.k: k = container spacing in pt (UIGlassContainerEffect.spacing / GlassEffectContainer(spacing:)), mapped 1:1 to CASDFLayer.smoothness
law.touch_threshold: two convex caps first touch at gap = k/2 (plus ~2*0.4 pt fill offset)
law.deformation_onset: facing surfaces begin to bulge toward each other at gap < k
law.aligned_edges: collinear/parallel edges get k' = 0: no lift (plain smin would lift them by k/4)

rejected.exponential_circular_cubic: global fits rms 1-38 pt at s>=20 (see merge-report.txt)

sdf_layer_params.CASDFLayer.smoothness: == spacing on every SDF layer of the container (output, gradient, fill, key/fill highlight), UIKit and SwiftUI

dynamic.hysteresis: none - drag in/out necks equal at equal gap, match the static law within 0.25 pt
dynamic.glassEffectID: elements spring in size about their own centre: a new member is born at 0.2 scale (12x8.8 for 60x44) at its final centre and grows (bouncy, ~0.34 s to peak, 1.03 overshoot); the leaving member shrinks back to 0.2 scale and stays inside the survivor; the fusion is the same sin^2 smooth-min with k = spacing throughout
dynamic.glassEffectUnion: members collapse into ONE element whose rect is their bounding box (capsule 150x44 for two 60x44 at gap 30); not a smooth-min

morph_recommendation.blend: blend (k) = Apple spacing, 1:1 in logical px; SwiftUI default spacing 8 == MorphSkinStyle.subtle (8)
morph_recommendation.smin: keep the mix-form polynomial but feed it k' = k * (1 - dot(na, nb)) / 2 per sample, na/nb = unit gradients of the accumulated field and of the next primitive
morph_recommendation.fold_gradient: accumulated gradient = mix(g_i, g_acc, h') with h' = clamp(0.5 + 0.5*(d_i - d_acc)/k', 0, 1) (the smin's own weight), renormalised before the dot
morph_recommendation.cluster_split_still_exact: k' <= k, so 'gap > k => plain min' and liquidConnectivityLabels stay valid
